description:
Goal

Make request-local compiler products fresh by construction. A product is an immutable answer derived from exact named fact and product reads; transport publisher membership and contributions are products too. No seal, completion pass, epoch-wide rescan, downstream reconstruction, or parallel freshness cache is permitted.

Signal

- Cache-hit and missing reads both become durable dependencies.
- Waiting extends dependencies; a conclusion replaces them.
- Product generations advance only when immutable values change.
- Exact scheduler movements invalidate direct readers at the next demand; equal recomputation does not move ancestors.
- Forward and reverse schedules produce identical values, generations, dependencies, and transport relations.
- The representative three-drive transport test remains in its pre-change performance range.
- Full library tests and deny-warning clippy pass with no spike instrumentation.

Strategy

1. Give ProductMemo immutable entries, generations, exact dependencies, reverse reader indexes, and demand-local dirty propagation.
2. Route production reads through ProductReadContext. Remove product-specific revision stamps, direct unstamped reads, and DemandFactsCache.
3. Preserve Scheduler FactChange movements and deliver borrowed slices to the live ProductDriver. Coalesce only each facts latest raw state until demand; never rescan World to reconstruct relevance.
4. Model shared executable facts as a product of authoritative upstream facts, removing the optional MaterializedExecutable-to-transport cycle.
5. Model OutgoingEdgeFrontier(root) as the order-free set of publishers actually requested in this driver. Model OutgoingInputEdges(publisher) as the publishers complete immutable slot-to-source contribution, and IncomingInputSlot(slot) as the exact union of named contributions. Remove append-only session edge inventories and push invalidation compensation.
6. Keep the legacy solved closure only as an isolated owner of its side-produced layouts. Index its exact fact consultations and member ownership. Retract only closures related to a moved fact or runtime-demand product; preserve unrelated closures. Shape may project a layout only through a live owning cover.
7. Delete temporary probes, counters, stale comments, and tests that pin the removed representations. Document the durable model.

Atomic boundary

Revisioned products alone exposed that append-only edge additions and whole-epoch closure clears repeatedly rebuilt large valid closures. The immutable frontier/contribution model and targeted closure retraction are therefore part of this same commit: neither intermediate is independently acceptable.

The closure solver itself remains legacy. This ticket does not introduce a closure product, publish fake component products, or replace the solver with raw position products. fz-k22.5 owns that refinement and the deletion of the remaining whole-closure inventory.

Acceptance

Permanent production-path tests cover dependency recording and replacement, exact fact movement and transient cancellation, equal-value stability through three levels, SCC side publication, frontier request lifecycle, outgoing replacement and withdrawal, incoming exact waits and no-edge publishers, order independence, live-cover ownership, and targeted closure retraction. Documentation matches the resulting contracts. cargo fmt --check, cargo test --lib, and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass.
title: Build revisioned products on exact outgoing and incoming transport facts
